title: Introduce endpoint priority sampler and trace compaction for low-SLA tenants
author: Diego Morales
release_notes: Adds endpoint-aware span sampling with tenant prioritization and a compacted trace export mode to reduce telemetry cost for low-SLA customers. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: telemetry costs for low-SLA tenants were growing disproportionally due to uniform span sampling and verbose trace exports. This change introduces an endpoint-aware priority sampler and a compact trace export mode so we can retain high-fidelity traces for critical paths while reducing cardinality and egress for lower-priority traffic.

What this PR does (single-string summary): Implements an endpoint-priority sampler that uses route tags, tenant SLA tier, and recent error-rate spikes to compute a sampling score; adds a compacted trace exporter that collapses low-importance spans and emits a concise invocation summary; exposes config knobs via the observability config map and a runtime override for rapid rollback.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked in ENG-4321
- [x] Runtime config with sane defaults and opt-in via feature flag
- [x] Unit tests for sampler scoring and compaction logic
- [x] Integration test in local trace-sim harness and perf microbench
- [x] Dashboard panels and alert tuning changes
- [x] Migration path and backfill script for historic rollups (offline)

Commits (high-level):
- implement: endpoint priority scoring engine and TTL cache for route metadata
- implement: compact trace exporter + compression schema v1
- config: observability config additions and feature flag gating
- tests: unit + integration + perf harness scenarios
- docs: console changelog and runbook for rollback

Changed areas (representative files):
- services/telemetry/sampler/priority_sampler.go (new)
- services/telemetry/exporter/compact_exporter.go (new)
- configs/observability/defaults.yaml (config knobs for sampling tiers)
- infra/k8s/overlays/observability-configmap.yaml (feature flag entries)
- internal/trace/sim/bench/priority_sampler_test.go (integration tests)
- docs/observability/compact-exporter.md (operational notes)

Notes on implementation: the sampler computes a numeric priority using weighted inputs: route_criticality (from route metadata), tenant_sla_score (mapped from tenant tier), recent_error_boost (short TTL), and sampling_budget_hint (from per-tenant budget endpoint). The compact exporter replaces sequences of short-lived housekeeping spans with a single "invoke.summary" span that records token counts, wall-time, and aggregated error counts. Exporter emits a compacted JSON envelope and a short base64 blob for very low-priority traces to preserve trace linkage while minimizing payload size.

Testing and perf: microbench shows ~18% reduction in telemetry bytes for the synthetic multi-tenant workload and ~0.5ms added p99 latency at the collector under heavy ingress (collector-side CPU-bound). Integration tests include a replay of a production trace sample and validation that high-priority routes retain full span fidelity.

Review conversation (summary):
- Aisha: asked for deterministic fallback when route metadata unavailable; implemented: TTL cache with fallback to global defaults.
- Samir: asked for guardrails around compaction to avoid losing user-facing spans; implemented: whitelist for span.name prefixes and a per-route allowlist config.
- Juno: requested metrics for "compaction_rate" and "compact_inflate_errors"; added both and updated dashboards.
- Author replies: clarified scoring math and added inline comments and a small helper in sampler_test.go to reproduce edge cases.

CI / checks: initial CI run flagged flakiness in the trace sim test (race on cache invalidation). Fixed by adding a protobuf marshal guard and retry in test; final CI: all checks green (unit, lint, integration, perf-smoke).

Dashboard & alerts: new panels added to /dashboards/observability/compact-exporter.json to show compaction_ratio by tenant, endpoint_priority_distribution and compacted_payload_size_hist. Updated SLO alert for telemetry egress to consider compaction-adjusted volume; added SRE runbook steps for rollback (disable feature flag -> redeploy config map -> flush collector cache).

Migration and rollout plan: rollout staged by region and tenant tier. Default behavior: feature flag off; enable for staging by 2026-01-21, enable for low-SLA tenants in us-west on 2026-01-27, monitor compaction_ratio and error spikes for 48h, then progressively enable for more tenants.

Merge outcome: squash-merged to main after approvals from reviewers and green CI. No downstream schema migrations required.
